title: Senior Systems Engineer - Commercial Radar Avionics (Onsite)

cond_0001.intro:
We're looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join the CNS (Communications, Navigation, and Surveillance) Radar Systems department in Avionics. You will work on a team that develops, integrates, and supports commercial radar avionics products for the Air Transport and Business and Regional aircraft markets. As part of the team, you will be involved in the design, development, integration, validation, and verification of airborne radar systems that provide weather detection and reduced crew operation capabilities.
The candidate is expected to demonstrate communication skills and an ability/desire to work in a team environment, establishing collaborative working relationships with peers and co-workers. The candidate must be adaptable to change, determined to accomplish tasks based on program schedule and contribute to a positive work environment. A successful candidate will consistently produce exemplary results on the projects and teams they collaborate with.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Support cross-functional teams to define the scope of development projects and initial product requirements as new designs move from concept, prototype to production.
Participate in cross-functional team efforts in integration and qualification testing for products and sub-systems of moderate to high complexity.
Develop tests and analysis methods to identify and resolve system performance issues.
Develop and conduct test plans and test procedures; and verify results of laboratory and flight testing in support of FAA certification.
Lead DO-160 ENV/EMI qualification testing efforts including developing test plans, procedures, and directing ENV/EMI lab testing including system and sub-system troubleshooting support.
Assist customers with aircraft troubleshooting, performing fault data analysis for fielded Radar units.
Assist with design related support for production failures and yield improvements.
Review performance metrics and defect trends, identify systemic root causes and process improvements and recommend new approaches, tools, and techniques that drive continuous improvement in systems development processes.
Estimate, track, and report status relating to technical performance, cost, schedule, and risk for assigned scope of work as well as for overall systems team performance.
Generate, coordinate, and participate in formal documentation reviews.
Provide technical training for less experienced engineers to ensure that quality standards are met.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years of prior relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience, or in absence of a degree, 9 years of relevant experience.
Domain knowledge of avionics products, RF/Analog/Digital systems, and experience working across multidisciplinary functional teams.
Previous systems engineering experience of product development and certification lifecycle processes.
Strong electrical background — ability to analyze hardware circuitry and perform root cause analysis.
Working RF knowledge of pulse power, sensitivity, dBm, noise figure.
Working knowledge of test equipment: Spectrum analyzers, Power Meters, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, VNAs.
Technical troubleshooting skills — testing at unit and system level.
Preferred Requirements
RADAR domain knowledge (Hardware/Software).
Experience with DO-160, DO-178, DO-254.
Matlab, LabVIEW, and JavaScript knowledge.

We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join our CNS (Communications, Navigation, and Surveillance) Radar Systems department in Avionics. In this role, you will work on a team that develops, integrates, and supports commercial radar avionics products for the Air Transport and Business and Regional aircraft markets. You will be involved in the design, development, integration, validation, and verification of airborne radar systems that provide weather detection and reduced crew operation capabilities.
We are looking for someone who can communicate clearly and work well in a team, building good working relationships with peers and co-workers. You should be adaptable, focused on meeting program schedules, and able to contribute to a positive work environment.
cond_0282.responsibilities: Support cross-functional teams to define the scope of development projects and initial product requirements as new designs move from concept, prototype to production. Participate in cross-functional team efforts in integration and qualification testing for products and sub-systems of moderate to high complexity. Develop tests and analysis methods to identify and resolve system performance issues. Develop and conduct test plans and test procedures; and verify results of laboratory and flight testing in support of FAA certification. Lead DO-160 ENV/EMI qualification testing efforts including developing test plans, procedures, and directing ENV/EMI lab testing including system and sub-system troubleshooting support. Assist customers with aircraft troubleshooting, performing fault data analysis for fielded Radar units. Assist with design related support-for production failures and yield improvements. Review performance metrics and defect trends, identify systemic root causes and process improvements and recommend new approaches, tools, and techniques that drive continuous improvement in systems development processes. Estimate, track, and report status relating to technical performance, cost, schedule, and risk for assigned scope of work as well as for overall systems team performance. Generate, coordinate, and participate in formal documentation reviews. Provide technical training for less experienced engineers to ensure that quality standards are met.
cond_0282.requirements:
A degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM), or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Around 5 years of relevant experience is typical, or around 3 years with an advanced degree. Candidates without a degree but with around 9 years of relevant experience are also considered.
Background in avionics products, RF/Analog/Digital systems, and experience working across multidisciplinary functional teams — or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Some experience with systems engineering in product development and certification lifecycle processes.
Electrical background with the ability to analyze hardware circuitry and work through root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of RF concepts such as pulse power, sensitivity, dBm, and noise figure.
Familiarity with test equipment including spectrum analyzers, power meters, signal generators, noise figure analyzers, and VNAs.
Ability to troubleshoot at unit and system level.
Exposure to RADAR domain (hardware/software) is a plus.
Experience with DO-160, DO-178, or DO-254 is helpful, or willingness to develop that knowledge.
Some familiarity with Matlab, LabVIEW, and JavaScript is useful.
cond_0282.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

cond_0342.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join the CNS (Communications, Navigation, and Surveillance) Radar Systems department in Avionics. Working alongside a team that develops, integrates, and supports commercial radar avionics products for the Air Transport and Business and Regional aircraft markets, you will help advance radar systems together with your colleagues. As part of this team, you will collaborate on the design, development, integration, validation, and verification of airborne radar systems that provide weather detection and reduced crew operation capabilities.
We are looking for someone with solid communication skills and a genuine interest in working cooperatively with peers and co-workers. The right candidate is adaptable, dependable in meeting program schedules, and contributes positively to the team.
cond_0342.responsibilities:
Support cross-functional teams to define the scope of development projects and initial product requirements as new designs move from concept, prototype to production.
Participate in cross-functional team efforts in integration and qualification testing for products and sub-systems of moderate to high complexity.
Work with the team to develop tests and analysis methods to identify and resolve system performance issues.
Develop and conduct test plans and test procedures; and help verify results of laboratory and flight testing in support of FAA certification.
Coordinate DO-160 ENV/EMI qualification testing efforts including developing test plans, procedures, and working with the ENV/EMI lab on testing including system and sub-system troubleshooting support.
Assist customers with aircraft troubleshooting, performing fault data analysis for fielded Radar units.
Assist with design related support for production failures and yield improvements.
Review performance metrics and defect trends together with the team, help identify systemic root causes and process improvements, and share recommendations for new approaches, tools, and techniques that support continuous improvement in systems development processes.
Estimate, track, and share status relating to technical performance, cost, schedule, and risk for assigned scope of work as well as for overall systems team performance.
Generate, coordinate, and participate in formal documentation reviews.
Provide technical guidance and training for less experienced engineers to help ensure quality standards are met.
cond_0342.requirements:
Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience or in absence of a degree, 9 years of relevant experience.
Domain knowledge of avionics products, RF/Analog/Digital systems, and experience in working across multidisciplinary functional teams.
Previous systems engineering experience of product development and certification lifecycle processes.
Strong Electrical background- ability to analyze hardware circuitry and perform root cause analysis.
Working RF knowledge of pulse Power, sensitivity, dBm, noise figure.
Working knowledge of Test equipment: Spectrum analyzers, Power Meters, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, VNAs.
Technical troubleshooting skills – testing unit and system level.
RADAR domain knowledge highly desired (Hardware/Software).
Experience with DO-160, 178, 254 is desired.
Matlab, LabVIEW, and JavaScript knowledge.

In this role you will work on a team that develops, integrates, and supports commercial radar avionics products for the Air Transport and Business and Regional aircraft markets. You will be involved in the design, development, integration, validation, and verification of airborne radar systems that provide weather detection and reduced crew operation capabilities.
The candidate is expected to demonstrate communication skills and an ability to work in a team environment, establishing collaborative working relationships with peers and co-workers. The candidate must be adaptable to change, determined to accomplish tasks based on program schedule, and contribute to a positive work environment.
cond_0371.responsibilities:
Support cross-functional teams to define the scope of development projects and initial product requirements as new designs move from concept, prototype to production.
Participate in cross-functional team efforts in integration and qualification testing for products and sub-systems of moderate to high complexity.
Develop tests and analysis methods to identify and resolve system performance issues.
Develop and conduct test plans and test procedures; and verify results of laboratory and flight testing in support of FAA certification.
Lead DO-160 ENV/EMI qualification testing efforts including developing test plans, procedures, and directing ENV/EMI lab testing including system and sub-system troubleshooting support.
Assist customers with aircraft troubleshooting, performing fault data analysis for fielded Radar units.
Assist with design related support for production failures and yield improvements.
Review performance metrics and defect trends, identify systemic root causes and process improvements and recommend new approaches, tools, and techniques that drive continuous improvement in systems development processes.
Estimate, track, and report status relating to technical performance, cost, schedule, and risk for assigned scope of work as well as for overall systems team performance.
Generate, coordinate, and participate in formal documentation reviews.
Provide technical training for less experienced engineers to ensure that quality standards are met.
cond_0371.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant field, or an advanced degree with minimum 3 years of proven experience, or in the absence of a degree, 9 years of substantial relevant experience.
Deep knowledge of avionics products, RF/Analog/Digital systems, with a proven track record of working across multidisciplinary functional teams.
Extensive systems engineering experience in product development and certification lifecycle processes.
Strong electrical background with demonstrated ability to analyze hardware circuitry and perform root cause analysis.
Solid understanding of RF concepts including pulse power, sensitivity, dBm, noise figure.
Strong command of test equipment: Spectrum analyzers, Power Meters, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, VNAs.
Proven technical troubleshooting skills at unit and system level.
RADAR domain expertise (Hardware/Software) highly desired.
Proficiency in DO-160, 178, and 254 is desired.
Advanced knowledge of Matlab, LabVIEW, and JavaScript.
cond_0371.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0371.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.
cond_0371.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunities employer committed to achieving 50/50 gender parity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply, and preference will be given to women in cases of equal qualification. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

cond_0391.intro:
We're looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join the CNS (Communications, Navigation, and Surveillance) Radar Systems department in Avionics. In this role you will work on a team that develops, integrates, and supports commercial radar avionics products for the Air Transport and Business and Regional aircraft markets. You will be involved in the design, development, integration, validation, and verification of airborne radar systems that provide weather detection and reduced crew operation capabilities.
The candidate is expected to demonstrate communication skills and an ability to work in a team environment, establishing collaborative working relationships with peers and co-workers. The candidate must be adaptable to change, determined to accomplish tasks based on program schedule, and contribute to a positive work environment. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of radar systems and avionics work involved.
cond_0391.responsibilities: Support cross-functional teams to define the scope of development projects and initial product requirements as new designs move from concept, prototype to production. Participate in cross-functional team efforts in integration and qualification testing for products and sub-systems of moderate to high complexity. Develop tests and analysis methods to identify and resolve system performance issues. Develop and conduct test plans and test procedures; and verify results of laboratory and flight testing in support of FAA certification. Lead DO-160 ENV/EMI qualification testing efforts including developing test plans, procedures, and directing ENV/EMI lab testing including system and sub-system troubleshooting support. Assist customers with aircraft troubleshooting, performing fault data analysis for fielded Radar units. Assist with design related support for production failures and yield improvements. Review performance metrics and defect trends, identify systemic root causes and process improvements and recommend new approaches, tools, and techniques that drive continuous improvement in systems development processes. Estimate, track, and report status relating to technical performance, cost, schedule, and risk for assigned scope of work as well as for overall systems team performance. Generate, coordinate, and participate in formal documentation reviews. Provide technical training for less experienced engineers to ensure that quality standards are met.

cond_0443.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join our CNS (Communications, Navigation, and Surveillance) Radar Systems department in Avionics. In this role you will work on a team that develops, integrates, and supports commercial radar avionics products for the Air Transport and Business and Regional aircraft markets. You will be involved in the design, development, integration, validation, and verification of airborne radar systems that provide weather detection and reduced crew operation capabilities.
The candidate is expected to demonstrate communication skills and an ability to work in a team environment, establishing collaborative working relationships with peers and co-workers. The candidate must be adaptable to change, determined to accomplish tasks based on program schedule, and contribute to a positive work environment.
cond_0443.responsibilities:
Support cross-functional teams to define the scope of development projects and initial product requirements as new designs move from concept, prototype to production.
Participate in cross-functional team efforts in integration and qualification testing for products and sub-systems of moderate to high complexity.
Develop tests and analysis methods to identify and resolve system performance issues.
Develop and conduct test plans and test procedures; and verify results of laboratory and flight testing in support of FAA certification.
Lead DO-160 ENV/EMI qualification testing efforts including developing test plans, procedures, and directing ENV/EMI lab testing including system and sub-system troubleshooting support.
Assist customers with aircraft troubleshooting, performing fault data analysis for fielded Radar units.
Assist with design related support for production failures and yield improvements.
Review performance metrics and defect trends, identify systemic root causes and process improvements and recommend new approaches, tools, and techniques that drive continuous improvement in systems development processes.
Estimate, track, and report status relating to technical performance, cost, schedule, and risk for assigned scope of work as well as for overall systems team performance.
Generate, coordinate, and participate in formal documentation reviews.
Provide technical training for less experienced engineers to ensure that quality standards are met.
cond_0443.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant field, or an advanced degree with minimum 3 years of proven experience, or in the absence of a degree, 9 years of substantial relevant experience.
Deep knowledge of avionics products, RF/Analog/Digital systems, with a proven track record of working across multidisciplinary functional teams.
Extensive systems engineering experience in product development and certification lifecycle processes.
Strong electrical background with demonstrated ability to analyze hardware circuitry and perform root cause analysis.
Solid understanding of RF concepts including pulse power, sensitivity, dBm, noise figure.
Strong command of test equipment: Spectrum analyzers, Power Meters, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, VNAs.
Proven technical troubleshooting skills at unit and system level.
RADAR domain expertise (Hardware/Software) highly desired.
Proficiency in DO-160, 178, and 254 is desired.
Advanced knowledge of Matlab, LabVIEW, and JavaScript.
